architecture.architecture:
SYNTHESIS VERDICT AND METHOD. This document adopts TERRITORY-NATIVE (candidate B) as the architectural spine — it is the only one of the three candidates whose D3 realization is grounded in code that actually matches the doctrine's own language, and the only one that resolves C3 (FAE-root seating) with evidence rather than punting (MINIMAL-ENRICHMENT) or ignoring it (PUBLIC-SURFACE-FIRST). I independently re-verified its load-bearing claims by reading the files myself (not trusting the judges' summary): apps/geode/src/declared-relations.mjs (251 lines, read in full), term-engineering-services-section/src/term-relation-keys.mjs and term-carrier.mjs, eavt.mjs (0.4.0), FAE's kernel/discharge.mjs and kernel/record-types.mjs, and witness-journal-rdf-projection-service/package.json. Every one of Territory-Native's central claims checked out verbatim: resolveTermRelationAuthority maps the FULL 58-predicate list (I recounted relation-predicates.json myself: 58, not 55 — both the doctrine text and candidate #0 are stale) onto every path in the caller's array with zero directory filtering (term-relation-keys.mjs line 8); declared-relations.mjs's own admission loop (lines 152-180) applies that authority vault-wide already, and only the keyword-web sub-mechanism (lines 182-215, guarded by TERM_DIRECTORY_MARKERS) is glossary-scoped. This makes PUBLIC-SURFACE-FIRST's headline claim -- "GEODE admits exactly ONE relation class, scoped only to glossary/terms/" -- demonstrably false: I read the file and the authorized-predicate admission phase is already vault-general, composed inside the SAME module PUBLIC-SURFACE-FIRST claims doesn't have it. I discard that design's Lot-1 framing (a "merge of two pipelines") entirely; there is one pipeline today with two sub-mechanisms of different scope, and the real gap is narrower than PUBLIC-SURFACE-FIRST states and roughly as MINIMAL-ENRICHMENT and TERRITORY-NATIVE describe it. I also confirmed: term-carrier.mjs's TERM_KEYS (9 admitted keys) has no consent-status field and already computes real unknown-key findings that are silently dropped, never turned into rows (line 85 vs admittedRecord's own findings-length gate at line 94) -- exactly as both A and B claim; eavt@0.4.0 (I read package.json) ships fold/settle/section/constituteEntity/entityAddress/dedupe exactly as described, a single symmetric join (line 334 fold, line 399 section) with no σ/Δ separate-nucleus pass; FAE's kernel/record-types.mjs literally comments "closed at design spec §3" above TIER_B_RECORD_TYPES (line 4); FAE's kernel/discharge.mjs literally defines SIGMA_CLOSURE = joinNucleus(FOUR.true), DELTA_CLOSURE = joinNucleus(FOUR.false), a PAIR.f/g pair, and a CORNER_OF_STATUS mapping, with a comment at line 8 reading "PyMetroLogic is not importable from JS" -- this is real, tested, production code whose shape is a near-verbatim match to org-layering's own EAVT-custody language ("σ and Δ are separate nuclei, never one lumped fold"). witness-journal-rdf-projection-service's package.json description literally reads "Projects strict SEAVT source rows... It does not own journal custody, trace, charge, or settlement" -- confirming the EAVT/SEAVT line concern in both A and B is real and GEODE's plain-EAVT ledger cannot be fed to it directly. bibliography-engineering-services-section and semantic-record-journal-service both exist exactly where claimed.

RESEQUENCING (the one structural change from Territory-Native's own build order, per the judges' verdict). Territory-Native's Lot 1 opens by extracting algebra out of FAE's kernel -- another section's live, tested, production substrate -- as the very first move. That is backwards for a solo-dev, usage-is-scarcest-resource shop: it is the heaviest, most cross-custody-coordinated lot in the whole design, opened before any self-contained value has shipped, and sits in tension with working-discipline's "a finding about another section's material is recorded, never fixed en passant" (C1 does authorize enrichment, but enrichment-first does not mean heaviest-lift-first). This synthesis grafts MINIMAL-ENRICHMENT's sequencing discipline instead: the low-risk, fully self-contained GEODE-side lots (eavt-backed row identity, typed refusals, consent-status, the vocabulary/IRI route, the backward-leg seam) ship first, each a small bounded diff to a file already read and understood; the FAE-kernel Settlement-locus extraction is deferred to the point where a real σ/Δ consumer actually needs it -- turning Territory-Native's best idea (reuse FAE's proven nucleus-pair algebra rather than hand-rolling a third copy) into a well-justified LATER lot instead of the riskiest first one. I also graft MINIMAL-ENRICHMENT's discipline of flagging unresolved math explicitly ("not yet computed") rather than assuming H0/H1 counts are a one-line addition, and its honest full drop (not a stub) of the papers pipeline's heaviest machinery from the v1 vertical slice while still giving it a first bounded lot per the doctrine's requirement that D5 be reserved, not merely mentioned.

I also graft from PUBLIC-SURFACE-FIRST, despite its central interface-misread, two genuinely correct pieces of design: (1) its two-regime RDF treatment -- a dereferenceable public slug-IRI graph kept structurally separate from, and only cross-linked to (rdfs:seeAlso / prov:wasDerivedFrom), the opaque ni:-witness SEAVT graph, never merged -- is the most doctrinally precise realization of D5's dual public-cone-leg / cryptographic-witness nature among the three designs, and replaces Territory-Native's less-differentiated "reuse encodeSrnAtom for RDF export" description; (2) its namespace reasoning -- mint IRIs at l-space.561.group/ns/term/<identity> and /ns/predicate/<name> rather than standing up a new ns.561.group zone before any external dereference demand exists, with the "graduate later" threshold named explicitly as a founder-shaped call -- which I confirmed is structurally sound: l-space already runs a Cloudflare Worker and already resolves term paths to rooms, so a second zone before real external traffic is unjustified hosting cost under the usage-is-scarcest-resource law. And (3) its correct identification of bibliography-engineering-services-section (confirmed to exist, with existing scripts/src/data/apps subdirectories) as the papers pipeline's real seat -- Territory-Native never engages the papers pipeline at all, which this synthesis treats as a real gap to close, not an omission to inherit silently.

DOCTRINE-BY-DOCTRINE REALIZATION (final).

D1 (two-legged codec). Forward leg = the generalized carrier-admission core (component 1 below), which is deliberately a small diff to the ALREADY vault-general declared-relations.mjs, not a new pipeline: add typed-refusal-row emission and eavt-backed row identity to what already resolves the full predicate authority for any path. Backward leg's v1 seam is a pure ranking function over data that ALREADY EXISTS: declared-relations.mjs's own `unnamed` count and `unresolved`/`defects` arrays (lines 147, 211-214, 225-226 -- read directly, not inferred) plus eavt's `section().contradicted` cells (once Lot 3 lands), ranked by a benefit (reference in-degree via eavt's relate/relateFrom) over cost (uniform, or defect count) heuristic. No new ingestion.

D2 (two orders, grow-only). Satisfied by construction via eavt's own append/dedupe/fold discipline (verified: dedupe is explicitly G-Set semantics, appendEavt never mutates prior rows, retraction is a tombstone). The generalized admission core routes every row's identity through eavt's rowId/dedupe (component 1) rather than GEODE's current bespoke sha256-slice witness; document/carrier identity (`e`) stays the stable filesystem path for v1 -- constituteEntity's kind:digest addressing is deliberately NOT applied to path identity yet, because (a) a stable, human-legible path is already a working natural key, (b) the glass-sponge note itself calls the kind:digest genesis address a sketch-lane stand-in "still pending its proof," and (c) re-keying path-identity touches every current consumer (l-space room resolution, DREW occurrence identity) and is exactly the kind of migration C6's no-big-bang-migration rule guards against. This is a deliberate, load-bearing correction to BOTH Territory-Native and Minimal-Enrichment's original candidate texts, which differed on this point without resolving it explicitly.

D3 (strata, open conjecture respected). Level 0 = raw appended rows, unchanged. Level 1 = eavt's existing fold/settle/section, reused verbatim -- confirmed this already IS the doctrine's "saturated" projection (one symmetric knowledge-join nucleus). Level 2 ("settled," H0 = Fix σ ∩ Fix Δ) is the genuinely new work: a SEPARATE σ/Δ nucleus-pair pass. For v1's bounded lots, this ships as two independent row-time-windowed reads inside DREW's existing FOUR-profile pipeline (t<=cutoff / t>cutoff) — cheap, additive, and never asserting the strata<->quartet identification as settled. The proven, doctrine-matching algebra already live in FAE's kernel/discharge.mjs (SIGMA_CLOSURE/DELTA_CLOSURE/PAIR/CORNER_OF_STATUS) is named as the CORRECT long-run target for level 2, extracted to its lawful theorem-locus seat under obsmetrological-services-section — but that extraction is sequenced LAST among the doctrine-bearing lots (Lot 7), not first, exactly as the resequencing above requires, and is explicitly flagged as touching another section's live production kernel, requiring coordination not en-passant edit.

D4 (metabolic loop). Promotion receipts fire on a level-1-to-level-2 transition, through semantic-record-journal-service (confirmed to exist, already the house journal mechanism) -- never as an eighth FAE Tier-B record type, because record-types.mjs's own comment confirms that enumeration is closed at design spec §3; conflating a knowledge-stratification receipt into an institutional-governance-fact register would itself violate D2's separate-orders requirement. H0/H1 counts and the commits/mints/jumps ledger are pure folds over these receipts, never separately maintained counter state -- this IS the run-integrity check (index balance: rows-in == affirmed+denied+contradicted+refused). No concrete anti-Landauer-yield formula is specified by any of the three source designs, and none is invented here either: v1 runs settle-corpus.mjs manually only, with the receipt itself recording the observed cost (batch size, wall time, defect count) as raw material for a future metabolic-criterion formula -- reserving the D4 seam honestly rather than pretending it is solved.

D5 (papers, vocabulary). Two structurally separate RDF regimes, as grafted from Public-Surface-First: (a) the existing opaque ni:-URI witness-journal-rdf-projection-service graph, confirmed by its own package.json to promise "strict SEAVT source rows" and (by its source, not independently re-read this pass) an opaque-token discipline -- reused unmodified, fed only from a new EAVT-to-SEAVT lift restricted to term-to-term relations (both e and v are admitted term IRIs, a is one of the 58 authorized predicates); (b) a new dereferenceable public slug-IRI graph at l-space.561.group/ns/term/<identity> and /ns/predicate/<name>, generated live (never hand-declared ttl) from the admitted term record, content-negotiated HTML (reusing l-space's existing room-rendering path) vs turtle/JSON-LD, cross-linked to (a) via rdfs:seeAlso/prov:wasDerivedFrom, never merged with it. The papers pipeline (triple-bound citation carriers, F10-style runnable gate, Zenodo deposit) is correctly seated in bibliography-engineering-services-section (confirmed to exist with its own scripts/src/data/apps layout) rather than as a new package -- given one small, bounded first lot (a citation-triple admission gate mirroring term-carrier.mjs's recognize*/admit* shape) so D5's "runnable gate" is reserved rather than only named, with the DOI-deposit and nanopub-head-graph work explicitly deferred past v1.

D6 (rule-based admission, typed refusal, consent). declared-relations.mjs is confirmed already fully rule-based (a CONCEPT regex, frontmatter-only, zero prose parsing). The genuine gap, confirmed by reading term-carrier.mjs lines 83-95: `recognizeTermMarkdown` already computes real `findings` (rule:"unknown-key" etc.) and gates `admitted` on `findings.length === 0`, but nothing ever turns a finding into a persisted row -- it is silently dropped from the corpus's evidential record the moment a term is refused. Lot 2 closes exactly this gap: findings become {e:path, a:"refused", v:{rule,message}, t:witness} EAVT rows. consent-status is added to TERM_KEYS/term.schema.json as an admitted optional scalar field, its value vocabulary left explicitly open pending a corpus grep (no-new-vocabulary law) rather than invented in this document.

C2 (DREW no-collapse) is honored throughout: document-link relations (keyword-web), concept-assertion relations (authorized-predicate frontmatter), and EAVT rows proper stay three distinct predicate families in the ledger's own row shape (`a` values partition cleanly: "declares-keyword" vs the 58 authorized predicates vs "refused"), never fused into one undifferentiated graph.

C3 (FAE-root seating) is answered NO for v1, using Territory-Native's verified evidence: apps/geode/src/fae-workspace-graph.mjs already composes GEODE's admitted graph as a STATELESS FAE PROVIDER (defineProvider/composeProviders) -- read-time, no data/ directory, no running daemon, no Tier-B governance semantics -- giving full DREW identity/provenance benefit at zero operational cost. Rooting science-services-section as a live FAE Tier A/B instance would violate both org-layering's data-custody law (data/ reserved for an actually-run FAE root) and the checkout-is-not-a-runtime doctrine (a live event log ticking over the corpus from bare-cedar-fog is exactly the named failure mode). The lawful path is extending the existing stateless provider composition, never minting a new root.

FIVE-CUSTODY THREAD. Science: term/predicate vocabulary and citation-triple semantics are science-services-section's theory, cited per existing `references:` frontmatter. Engineering: the components below, each seated in its already-existing owning package. Operations: the publish gate (diff against published tarball, fresh-install tests, additive-only) on every touched package; no new systemd units, no new Cloudflare zone in v1. 561-group: semantic-record-journal-service receipts and the manual settle-corpus pass are the org's own running of this capability. Public: l-space.561.group/ns/* and (deferred) the papers pipeline's Zenodo/DOI face are the two world-facing surfaces this design was pulled backward from.
buildOrder: Lot 1 — Ledger truth: add @red-cup-engineering/eavt as a GEODE dependency; replace witnessOf/eavtRowsOf with eavt's rowId/dedupe in declared-relations.mjs. Gate: existing declared-relations tests and apps/drew's test suite stay green unmodified (DREW's createGeodeDeclaredRelationsAdapter must treat `t` as opaque, verified not assumed); new test asserts two distinct assertions never collide on rowId.

Lot 2 — Typed refusals + consent-status: wire term-carrier.mjs's already-computed unknown-key findings and declared-relations.mjs's already-computed unnamed/unresolved/defects into persisted {e,a:"refused",v:{rule,message},t} rows for term/ paths (the only carrier kind with a real schema — TERM_KEYS — to refuse against in v1); add consent-status to TERM_KEYS/term.schema.json. Gate: term-carrier tests green + new test proving an unauthorized frontmatter key on an admitted term produces a persisted refused row (never a silent drop) and consent-status round-trips through admit/render/recognize without breaking existing (unmodified) term carriers.

Lot 3 — Windowed sigma/Delta PAM readings (interim strata): additive row-time-window parameter on DREW's existing pam()/app surface. Gate: DREW's existing test suite green (additive-only per its own publish gate) + new test asserting sigma(cutoff) and Delta(cutoff) partition rows correctly and never share evidence across the cutoff; module comment explicitly disclaims the strata<->quartet identification as an open conjecture.

Lot 4 — Term/predicate IRI vocabulary surface + dual-regime RDF distinction: apps/geode/src/vocabulary.mjs + new /ns/term|predicate/<slug> routes on l-space's existing Cloudflare Worker (no new zone). Gate: an admitted term dereferences at /ns/term/<identity> with valid, parseable JSON-LD generated live from the record (no ttl file read); the generated public graph carries a distinct rdfs:seeAlso edge and is verified structurally separate from any ni: witness node (no shared node identity).

Lot 5 — Backward-leg authorship-demand seam: apps/geode/src/authorship-demand.mjs. Gate: new unit test with a fixture vault containing one contested cell and one dangling link, asserting nonzero ranked output with monotonic benefit/cost ordering.

Lot 6 — EAVT-to-SEAVT lift + RDF export, term-relations only: term-engineering-services-section/scripts/lift-term-relations-to-seavt.mjs calling witness-journal-rdf-projection-service's existing, unmodified projectSeavtRdf. Gate: a term-to-term relation round-trips through the projector's own verification discipline; a relation touching a non-term carrier is confirmed REJECTED/excluded by the lift, not silently coerced.

Lot 7 — Citation-triple carrier + admission gate (papers, first bounded cut): bibliography-engineering-services-section/src/citation-triple.mjs, a small new paper-predicate authority list distinct from the 58 term predicates. Gate: recognize*/admit* round-trip tests mirroring term-carrier.test.mjs's own shape; a triple reconciles cleanly against the section's existing collect/reconcile exports. Nanopub head-graph and Zenodo DOI deposit are explicitly NOT part of this lot.

Lot 8 — Manual settling pass + receipts: apps/geode/scripts/settle-corpus.mjs orchestrating Lots 1-5. Gate: run against a small fixture batch; exactly one receipt lands via semantic-record-journal-service, round-trips through its own read API, indexBalance holds; H0/H1 explicitly recorded as 'not yet computed' (Lot 9 not yet landed).

Lot 9 (deferred, sequenced late deliberately) — Settlement-locus algebra extraction from FAE's kernel to its lawful theorem-locus seat, replacing Lot 3's interim windowed reads with the doctrine-precise σ/Δ nucleus pair once a real consumer needs the distinction Lot 3's approximation can't give. Gate: FAE's own full test suite stays green under its publish gate (diff against published tarball, fresh install); this is coordinated with FAE's own custody as a finding, not landed en passant — do not start this lot without first checking what FAE's own current maintainers/records say about its kernel's stability.

Lot 10 (the vertical-slice proof, not new code) — Admit one real science note carrying a relation to an admitted glossary-term concept; run settle-corpus.mjs; verify admitted → settled (sigma reading readable via DREW/l-space) → served (l-space route) → /ns/term/<concept> dereferences with JSON-LD, structurally distinct from the SEAVT witness graph → exactly one receipt written. This run is the acceptance gate for calling v1 shipped.

Explicitly deferred past v1 (named, not silently dropped): science-services-section as a live FAE Tier A/B root (answered NO for v1 per C3, using the existing stateless fae-workspace-graph.mjs provider composition instead); nanopub head-graph export and Zenodo DOI deposit (Lot 7 ships only the admission gate); a general (non-term) vault typed-refusal schema; any MAPE-K scheduler for settle-corpus.mjs.
candidate0Critique: Step 1 overclaims that GEODE's declared-relations needs to be 'generalized... against the 55 authorized predicates' as new work — I read declared-relations.mjs and term-relation-keys.mjs directly: the authorized-predicate admission phase (lines 137-180) already resolves the FULL predicate list against every path in the caller's array with zero directory filtering (resolveTermRelationAuthority maps every path to the full predicate list unconditionally). The real gap is narrower: turning already-computed but silently-dropped findings/unnamed/unresolved data into persisted refusal rows, and adopting eavt's row identity in place of the bespoke sha256-slice witness. The predicate count itself is also stale: I recounted relation-predicates.json myself at 58, not 55.

Step 1's implicit assumption that every carrier should be constituted via eavt's constituteEntity (kind:digest addressing) is unproven-benefit indirection for v1: a stable, human-legible filesystem path is already a working natural key for document identity, re-keying it touches every current path-keyed consumer (l-space room resolution, DREW occurrence identity), and the glass-sponge note itself calls the kind:digest genesis address a sketch-lane stand-in still pending its proof. Fix: adopt eavt's rowId/dedupe for ROW identity (the real, verified gap) while keeping path-as-e for document identity in v1.

Step 2's plan to build sigma/Delta strata logic as new code inside eavt.mjs would duplicate two things that already exist: eavt's own fold/settle/section (verified: a single symmetric knowledge-join, already the 'saturated' level) AND, more importantly, FAE's kernel/discharge.mjs's asymmetric SIGMA_CLOSURE/DELTA_CLOSURE nucleus pair — verified live, production code, explicitly commented as a hand-mirror of PyMetroLogic's quartet math because Python isn't importable from JS. A third hand-rolled copy (after JS-in-FAE and Python-in-PyFARS) is exactly the duplication C1 forbids. Fix: reuse eavt's fold/settle verbatim for level 1; use DREW's windowed-read approximation for v1's level 2 (bounded, cheap); extract FAE's proven algebra to its lawful theorem-locus seat as a deliberately LATE lot, not conflated into step 2's early sequencing.

Step 2 also implicitly assumes H0/H1 counts are a straightforward addition to a settling script; no confirmed Cohomology-seated function was found in metrologic's proof tree in this pass. Fix: the receipt explicitly records 'not yet computed' until that lookup is confirmed, per org-layering's seating-is-a-lookup law — never hand-rolled ad hoc cohomology math to fill the gap.

Steps naming witness-journal-rdf-projection-service as the direct D5 export path silently cross the EAVT/SEAVT line: I verified the package's own package.json description says 'Projects strict SEAVT source rows... does not own journal custody, trace, charge, or settlement' — GEODE's declared-relations ledger is plain EAVT (bare-string e/a/v, document-hash witness). Feeding it straight to this projector would either fail the service's contract or smuggle untyped strings through a service that promises typed SEAVT semantics. Fix: an explicit EAVT-to-SEAVT lift scoped to term-to-term relations only, before the existing projector is touched.

No step names bibliography-engineering-services-section (confirmed to exist, with its own src/scripts/data/apps layout already wired to semantic-record-journal-service) as the papers pipeline's real seat — treating papers as new-pipeline work risks the built-in-parallel-of-existing failure C1 warns against. Fix: seat the citation-triple admission gate there explicitly, as its own bounded first lot.

The seven-step build order has no per-step green-test gate and no explicit acceptance criterion, under-delivering on C6's 'small number of bounded lots' by omission. This synthesis's build order attaches a concrete, independently verifiable gate to every lot, and explicitly names what is deferred rather than leaving the cut line implicit.
